outcome: Knowledge and expectations of pregnant women regarding perinatal care during COVID-19 pandemic
Agreement with separation of mother-infant after birth
Agreement with visitor restrictions during postnatal period
Agreement with changes in confinement practices
Beliefs about breastfeeding safety with active COVID-19
cohort: 313 pregnant women ≥21 years old, without a history of confirmed COVID-19, attending antenatal clinics in August-September 2020
finding: Expectant mothers showed uncertainty regarding the optimal delivery method and breastfeeding safety with COVID-19, and displayed varied agreement towards changes in standard perinatal care during the pandemic.
mod_finding: Most participants (77%) were unsure about the optimal mode of delivery during the COVID-19 pandemic.
